faq.question: Is the Product Management course free?
faq.answer: Yes. The complete course, including all learning modules, quizzes, and the Certificate of Completion, is free

faq.question: Is the course self-paced?
faq.answer: Yes. Learners can complete the videos and module assessments at their own pace.

faq.question: How many modules are included?
faq.answer: The course contains 6 modules covering the complete Product Management learning journey.

faq.question: Are there assessments?
faq.answer: Yes. Each module ends with a short five-question quiz to help learners check their understanding.

faq.question: Will I receive a certificate?
faq.answer: Yes. Learners who successfully complete the required course assessments can earn the course certificate at no additional cost.

faq.question: Do I need prior Product Management experience?
faq.answer: No prior Product Management experience is required. The course is designed to build the concepts progressively.

faq.question: Is there a deadline to complete the course?
faq.answer: Yes. Your course access will remain active for 60 days from the date of activation. We recommend completing all 6 modules and the required assessments within this period.
